registers.name: ID0
registers.purpose: Manufacturer/device identification, row/column address bit counts, device-size information.

registers.name: CR0
registers.purpose: Deep Power Down enable (HyperRAM), output Drive Strength, Initial Latency count (3..7 clocks), Fixed/Variable Latency select, Burst Length (16/32/64/128 bytes) + Hybrid Burst enable, Burst Type default.

registers.name: CR1
registers.purpose: Refresh interval / distributed-refresh control (HyperRAM) and other device-specific options.

base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: HyperBus devices expose a small register space (selected by Address Space = 1 in the Command-Address): read-only Identification Registers ID0/ID1 and read/write Configuration Registers CR0/CR1. CR0/CR1 set the operating parameters (initial latency count, fixed/variable latency, output drive strength, burst length / hybrid burst, deep power down, refresh control). A register access uses R/W#=0/1 with Address Space=1 in the CA.

register_access.configured_at: power-up defaults; reprogrammed by the host before high-frequency operation

register_fields_cr0: Burst Length (16 / 32 / 64 / 128 bytes) + Hybrid Burst enable
